state:
Goal `core-validate-and-1-more` is met. Both stage-2 checks pass: `bun nv proofs --verify --group 'Core\Validate'` and `--group 'Core\Xml'` each report nothing owed and 0 failed.
`Core\Xml` has its class card, and `parse`, `reader` and `writer` have plain cards and every proof, with perf recorded in `docs/perf/members.ndjson`.
The attack on `parse` found two bugs, both fixed and pinned by `.nvst` and Rust tests: a repeated-attribute check that was quadratic in the number of attributes, and a literal control character that the parser accepted.
The attack on `writer` found a third, recorded as gap `nvs-stdlib/an-xml-writer-holds-a-string-per-piece` (milestone M12) and marked on `tests/hostile/core/Xml/writer/01-calls-in-the-wrong-order.nvs`.
Uncommitted edits to `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/lib.rs` are not this loop's, and no commit here stages them.
Nothing is blocked.

items.text: **One in-place string for a writer's output** — `Pen::emit` at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/xml.rs:2762` pushes each piece as its own string, and `end_document` at `crates/nvs-stdlib/src/xml.rs:2897` joins them. Hold one string only the writer references and append in place, as `nvs_str_append` does. Then drop the `// proof: gap` marker from the writer attack (`rule:testing/a-failing-proof-is-fixed-or-recorded`).
